criterion: Data re-entry / One way per task
description: Opening a vein from Goals (or from an Activity subject) wipes the person's Assigned to and Status filter, while choosing the same vein in the board's Vein select keeps them. Getting the personal view back takes three control changes.
expected: Opening a vein keeps the other filters (as the Vein select does), or offers a one-click "Back to my filters".
actual: Filters reset to All Actors / All statuses; restoring takes 3 controls.
suggested_fix: Make showVein set only the vein filter, or keep a restorable previous-filter snapshot.

description: View switches (Goals → Tasks) and filter changes create no browser history entries, so the browser Back button leaves Pardner entirely instead of returning to Goals.
expected: Back returns to the previous view and filters.
actual: Back navigates away from the app (blank page in the walk).
suggested_fix: Push view and vein filter into the URL (hash or query) with history.pushState.
